chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥajjāl, from Ḥammād, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام; and he mentioned the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, then he said:
Amir al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: Allah has not created any living being better than Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.بَرَأَ: created or brought forth into existence
key_terms.مُحَمَّدٍ: Prophet Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله, the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kāfī narrate about the superiority of Prophet Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله over creation?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the supreme excellence of Prophet Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله over all created beings. It presents this rank through the statement of Amir al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, highlighting the unmatched status of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله in creation.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hajjal, from Hammad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> mentioned Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has not Created any creature better than Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. om Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hajjal from Hammad from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following. When mentioning the the Messenger of Allah he said, “
Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) has said, “Allah has not created any creature better than Muhammad (s.a.).”
